steps.text: Yes, I got it down after one try. Your brother did too.
But it's alright. You're the youngest, so of course you won't be as good as us right away.
Let's take it one step at a time. If you don't succeed at first, just try again. If you can't get it today, pick it up tomorrow.
As long as you eventually learn it, why does it matter if it takes you a little longer?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Reporting! I've returned the last case of etched ammo to storage, and put the equipment and materials back in their places.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Jessica, are you really leaving?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Oh, um, yes. Sorry...

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: *sigh*... It's not easy for new recruits to pass our training and examinations. Now that you've officially joined Blacksteel, shouldn't you be full of excitement and fighting spirit? At least for a while?

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Plus, you were trained by Instructor Eyland.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I only barely based the exam, and Instructor Eyland... Umm...

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: You're still new. You can't expect everything to go smoothly the first time.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Why are you so adamant on leaving Blacksteel anyway? Did getting hurt on that one mission spook you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No, it was just a scratch, but...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Well, it's fine. We all have our own reasons, so if there's something you're struggling with, I won't pry.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: What did you think about the explosive-resistant shield you just tested?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Umm... I think it was made from a newly-developed Raythean material, and felt like it would be effective against most kinds of projectiles.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But overall, it felt a bit unwieldy... Ah, s-sorry, I should've been incorporating more strength training into my daily exercise.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: I won't deny, the design is a bit clunky for a Feline. Your judgment is as sharp as ever.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: You've been great, Jessica. We were able to get a ton of data from you carrying it through the whole trial.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: D-Don't mention it, I'm just doing my job... My last job here.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: I suppose so. It's a shame we're losing such a capable tester.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I still have a long way to go. Sorry...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm off to HR now.

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Sure, alright then. See you later, Jessica.
Excuse me, is Jessica here?

steps.name: Testing Supervisor
steps.text: Jessica? She just left, and should be on her way to HR. If there's something you want to tell her, I'll pass on the message the next time I see her.
That's alright, I'll go look for her myself.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (I guess I'm supposed to wait here...)

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Thank you very much. Our technical cooperation with Blacksteel has always been the most important part of Raythean's business, and we are especially grateful for your assistance, Mr. 'Clip.'

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Manager
steps.text: Haha, that was years ago. Plus, I'd reckon there are few suppliers other than Raythean that could meet Blacksteel's demand.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: That's true. The development and improvement of etched ammo has always been one of our top R&D priorities.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I hope we'll get to chat again next quarter, after the orders have been docked.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Manager
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Good. Then, I'll take my leave.

steps.name: Blacksteel Senior Manager
steps.text: Oh, you were looking for Brynley's daughter, right...? How's he doing? Tell him I said hello.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Haha, thank you for your concern. I'll let him know.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Good day, Madam 'Jessica.' I am...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: G-Good day, Mr. Raymond. Of course I remember you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There's no need to be so formal with me.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Yes, of course. Such is Brynley's pride and joy. Thoughtful, and unpretentious.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: So how was it? Did you have a good time here?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Well... Blacksteel's training is rigorous, and I feel like I've been steadily improving. But I've still got a long way to go until I can become a qualified mercenary.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: It seems like you've also found this trip worthwhile. That's great to hear.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I believe you and your father have not seen each other for two years, right? Mr. Brynley has been waiting for you to return home.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Are you through with the resignation procedures? And is your luggage prepared? I'll have someone over to load everything onto the transport.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Mr. Raymond, um, w-wait a minute please...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Hm? Is something amiss?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The last time you came here, you said that Father wanted me to return home... but if I found my own path at Blacksteel Worldwide, I'd be allowed to stay.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: So, I want to know...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I see. At first, Mr. Brynley acknowledged your ambitions and allowed you to join Blacksteel, to broaden your horizons and find yourself.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: But he's come to learn that Blacksteel has been smothering your abilities, and though he is filled with regrets, he still allowed you three months to decide whether you wanted to stay.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I understand... My performance here has not been enough to earn Father's acknowledgement.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry. I tried my best, but...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: No, I should be apologizing, Madam Jessica. I might be repeating myself here, but I hope you'll hear me out. Your father wants you to go home for a variety of reasons.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: You're currently working in the Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies. Blacksteel can take full advantage of your background here, but for you, there's no denying that you're vastly overqualified.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You know I'm not very talented...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: The top-of-the-line equipment you handle here at Blacksteel is nothing but the product of endless internal testing at Raythean.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Since you're interested in this work, why not return to Raythean, where you can truly flex your muscles and make a difference?

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: And this hardly bears repeating, but it is your family business, after all.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: By your father's side, you are guaranteed to have all the resources you could ever want at your disposal, as well as the room to fully express yourself.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: You wouldn't need to work your way up from a lowly equipment tester, nor would your contributions go ignored for long periods, as they are now.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Look at you. You hardly look like the scion of the Brynley family.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sorry... I'm just too useless...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Come on now, Madam Jessica, enough with the self-deprecation.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: By the way, I heard you were injured on a recent field mission. Is that true?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um, it's because I didn't train enough and got too nervous in a combat situation... Sorry, I still need to polish my skills more.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I see. You understand now, right? Being a mercenary is a dangerous, life-threatening affair.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: No matter how hard you train, there's always the risk of injury.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I also have a young daughter, and I also understand the love Mr. Brynley has for you, so please don't take this the wrong way.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Mr. Brynley encouraged his children to go out on their own, as a good father should, and he would've appreciated it if you were able to start something of your own, like your sister did.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: But, you are his youngest daughter. Mr. Brynley still hopes that you can draw on the experiences of those who've come before you, suffer fewer hardships, take fewer detours, and return home as soon as possible.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Compared to your brother and sister, you're not as socially skilled as them, nor have you dedicated yourself to mechanical design.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Carving out a domain for yourself relying solely on your physical prowess and combat abilities is still out of your reach.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You're certainly not wrong...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Raymond... I keep letting you and my father down.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Nonsense. Besides, Raythean can always make you a custom set of equipment to enjoy on your return.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: If you had better protective gear, you would've been fine in a small skirmish like that.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But even if I had access to the best gear... what would I be able to do with it?

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: All that matters you put the equipment we've painstakingly made to good use. You don't have to think too hard about what you want to do with it.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Oh right, Fort Barron is still a fair distance away. Could you enjoy desserts made by a gold-medal chef here?

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I remember when you came to my office a number of years ago, Mr. Brynley directed me to order an entire table of desserts.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um... Training here involves strict dieting...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Though, I still buy snacks every now and then... Ugh, if only I had more self-discipline.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Please don't be too tough on yourself, Madam Jessica. I think you've worked hard enough.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Earlier, I spoke to Mr. Eyland, your training instructor, and he didn't have much of an impression of you, except the fact that you train very hard.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Even a respected, elite mercenary like Eyland found nothing lacking in your performance. Though you didn't particularly stand out either, your hard work helped you narrowly pass the exam.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: What is there to blame yourself for?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Instructor Eyland...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sorry... I get nervous just thinking about him...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Good grief, this is exactly what Mr. Brynley has been worried about. You've already endured so much hardship here.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: But I'm glad to see that you've put up with all of it. You've now gained valuable experience, and honed your already excellent qualities. If you were to return home, I'm sure you'd...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I haven't finalized my resignation process yet, and... um, before I leave, I'd like to... say goodbye to my friends. Can I have a bit more time?

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: *sigh*... I'm afraid this will disrupt the schedule, and your father is waiting for you to return home... But of course, it's all up to you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: A-Alright... Sorry again...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'll head back to the HR Department then...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Phew... haah.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...The wind on the barrens.
In a corner of the empty outdoor training ground, Jessica closes her eyes and forcefully inhales the air that reeks with the scent of Originium gunpowder.
She silently spent countless hours of her leisure time here in order to pass the examination that fails out nearly 80% of new recruits.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Have I experienced all of this vast, boundless land?)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Not quite, right?)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Outside of a few small skirmishes, I've stayed back at the base most of the time, training and testing.)
Two years ago, for the first time, she mustered up the courage to talk to her father about the steps she was about to take.

Her family had already selected a school and specialization for her advanced studies. She even had her job after graduation planned out for her, but she wanted to submit her resume to Blacksteel Worldwide.
She told her father that she still didn't know what she was capable of, so she wanted to further refine herself.
Besides, her father always said that the land was vast and boundless, holding infinite possibilities in life.
So she wanted to experience more in life, and find her own possibilities.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (But, I've already finished packing my bags.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (And I think... I'm done saying my goodbyes.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry... I couldn't accomplish anything in the end...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Eek––!
What's the matter with you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, um...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm really sorry! I, I was just...
Wait, don't run off–

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm from the BPRS Division, codename 'Liskarm.' You're Jessica, right?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yes! H-Hello, Liskarm, ma'am...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I was just looking for you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The colleagues in your department said you went to the training grounds, but the staff there said they hadn't seen you. Luckily I was passing by the outdoor training area and decided to take a look, and lo and behold.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I was hoping to talk to you personally.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I've had a change of station and I'm now in need of a deputy. After sifting through Blacksteel's HR files, I thought you'd be the best fit for the position.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: O-Okay... Wait, huh?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You mean... You want me to as your deputy? Me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes. I'm looking for a capable all-rounder.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But, I don't think I'm...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I don't know much about your specific abilities other than the exam data in the files. But, I sat down and had a chat with Joseph, and he thought you'd be a good fit.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Joseph... Instructor Eyland? But, he said he didn't have much of an impression of me...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Huh? No, we happened to have time to chat over dinner a couple days ago, and he thought you'd make an excellent deputy, and a good fit for my personal style.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: He told me how you thought it'd be impossible to pass the selection examination, but you still spent every day in the training grounds.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Are you alright? You look like you're having a hard time.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, I'm sorry...!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I was actually about to leave Blacksteel...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Are you having second thoughts?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You seem pretty attached to these training grounds. Why are you leaving?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Because I haven't done a good job.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Did you already return your gun?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: N-Not yet...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then draw it out and show me what you've got. Treat this as a practical.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: R-Right here? But, there's no protective gear...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't worry, I've got my shield. Plus, didn't you launch an attack on Joseph during a live combat training session that even he wasn't able to neutralize?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-That was just an accident!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Not bad. You're a pretty nice shot. Acceptable accuracy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But your bullets... don't have enough of a bite.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't look away. Keep your eyes on your opponent––

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Good reactions. You've got the conditioned reflexes. That's a product of your training.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But live combat situations are always trickier than training.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Waah!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sorry... I wasn't able to dodge...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You've already passed. You don't know my Arts.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Alright, on your feet.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Did I... really pass?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes. I have to say I don't agree that you 'haven't done a good job.' You just aren't experienced or practiced enough, but that's true for all fresh recruits.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Not experienced enough...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Liskarm, ma'am, may I ask you a question?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hm? Even though I'll be asking you to train, I'm not much of an instructor myself... Well, whatever, what is it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: When... did you realize you were cut out to be a mercenary?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Cut out to be a mercenary? Still don't know if I am, and haven't thought much about it. All I know is it's what I want to do.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But—
What if you're not a good fit for the job? Aren't you afraid you'll end up having to take detours?
––Or, maybe, people's lives shouldn't have to roll down a single, predetermined track. Pick a road and follow it through, wherever it might lead.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Thank you. Thank you for acknowledging me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I think...
She clenches her fist, just as she had done that day when she stood in front of her father's office.
This is what 'Jessica,' Blacksteel mercenary, decided for herself.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...I would like to take this opportunity.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Good, very good.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But just so we're clear, I'm warning you in advance that my BPRS is a very unique division... It's fringe work, and always extremely dangerous.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We deal with Infected organisms and acute Originium contamination incidents, to give you an idea of the risks involved.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, I understand...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: When facing a normal operation, most injuries you might suffer can be fully healed. But when you're out with BPRS, more serious wounds might mean that you contract Oripathy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I've seen enough of your files to know that you sustained minor injuries on your last mission.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course, BPRS is equipped with comprehensive protective measures, and Director Janet has been working hard to improve the division's emergency responses, to reduce the risk of infection.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Also, if you become my deputy, I'll have higher expectations for your training. I will not deploy you on dangerous missions until you've fully met those expectations.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So that's the situation. I came to you before starting an inter-department transfer application, just so you can decide what you want to do.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Thank you... But I've already made up my mind!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'll continue to broaden my experiences, and get more rigorous training... Then, I'll find my own answers.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: N-Not just answers to my own questions, but also those about life and how to live it... In the course of my missions, I've seen things that I'm still confused about, even now.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Is that so? I apologize, but I might not be able to give you the answers you're looking for.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But I'm glad that my deputy thinks about these same issues.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Your deputy...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Were you going to HR to finish your resignation? I'll go with you, make it easier to withdraw the application.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ah, yes, alright... Thank you very much!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But, what should I say to Mr. Raymond and Father...

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Is something wrong, Madam Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I can't exactly wander around inside Blacksteel, so I went outside.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: If I heard correctly, you said you were withdrawing your resignation application?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Liskarm...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No, it's fine. I'm sorry, Mr. Raymond, but I don't plan on going home.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Please... tell my father, that 'Jessica' wants to stay with BSW no matter what. As a mercenary working for a security firm, protecting people, solving problems.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I haven't found what my 'possibilities' are yet, but I want to keep searching.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Raythean Industries Representative
steps.text: I will let him know.
My little girl still wants to keep being 'Jessica' of Blacksteel Worldwide...? That stubbornness is exactly what you'd expect from a child of the Brynley family.

I apologize for making you say so many harsh things to her, but I need to know that she's strong enough to find her own footing, not just drifting along the currents in the one place she's been thrown.
Of course, I'd prefer not to see her suffer. There is too much cruelty in this world, and she will have many questions to which there are no easy answers.
But if she wants to be a challenger, then so be it. Even if she's the last child in the family to find out what she should do in life... or she never finds it.
